title: Bit Rotate
text: Rotate input signal by bit positions, 1 input, 1 output; {Rotate Mode} Specifies direction of rotation, left or right Rotate and {Rotate Length} Specifies the number of bits to rotate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rotate Mode
params.values: Specifies direction of rotation, left or right Rotate Left (default) | Rotate Right

params.name: Rotate Length
params.values: Specifies the number of bits to rotate 0 (default) | integer greater than or equal to zero
